description: ember_rex_2 default look (v2b), LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the regenerated Pixal3D proxy's own texture (body darkened to a muted red, fire pushed to bright saturated orange -> yellow -> pale-yellow cores, cream neck, crisp yellow-orange eyes) baked onto the low (improved/textures/ember_rex_2_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it; four GLOW regions carry the emission (Glow -> Emission Color): the three flame bands (base / tips / hot cores) and the leg cracks. The body is unlit

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode); white keeps the texture as baked. Sheet chips for reference: 68,38,42 / 161,42,48 / 225,76,58 / 253,124,67 / 253,201,100 / 246,214,182

flame_core.note: UNIT V2 NOTE 2: the hot pale-yellow flame cores (baked L* >= 87), the brightest glow; rgb white keeps the baked albedo

flame_tips.note: the yellow flame tips (baked L* >= 76, b* >= 45; sheet chip 253,201,100); v1's single flame region was 253,150,70 x 0.35

flame_base.note: the orange flame body incl. the collar band / crest / chest flame (baked L* >= 56, b* >= 45; sheet chip 253,124,67); scale 0.3 (run 1 at 0.6 flattened the per-face glow into uniform shards)

leg_cracks.note: the glowing leg cracks (sheet 'glowing, flame-lit texture'); v1 244,130,85 x 0.6
